title: cerastium nutans var. apricum
intro: Cerastium nutans var. apricum, commonly known as Rock Jenny or Spring Cress, is a type of flowering plant in the carnation family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Cerastium nutans var. apricum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
